name: aab-build
summary: Build a signed Android App Bundle from an Expo project and copy it to a versioned output path.

patches.change: Add steps before upload to: decode and verify the upload keystore with prepare-upload-keystore.sh, resolve the next versionCode from PLAY_MAX_VERSION_CODE with resolve-version-code.mjs (after the play-version-code step), and run build-aab.mjs with APP_VERSION, APP_BUILD_NUMBER and the ANDROID_UPLOAD_* signing values. See the README for the exact wiring.
